WADE (World Alliance for Decentralized Energy) (2003). Guide to Decentralized Energy Technologies. WADE, 15 Great Stuart Street, Edinburgh EH3 7TP, UK. No DOI; www.localpower.org.

Introductory 48-page trade guide; locators are printed page numbers (cover and contents unnumbered; introduction pages i-iv, body 1-40). Loaded: cost range tables for steam turbines (Table 1), open-cycle gas turbine and CCGT/cogeneration (Table 2), reciprocating engines (3), Stirling (4), microturbines (5), fuel cells (7) with installed capex, O&M, levelized cost at 8000/4000 (and 2000 for Stirling) h/yr and the footnoted levelization assumptions (8% discount rate, ten-year payback); fuel-cell type summary (Table 6); Table 10 summary of efficiency and size by prime mover; recycled-energy capex (p.30). All numbers are printed ranges with no central value, so value is blank. Skipped: small hydro, PV, wind, regulation text. Traps: (1) no price year or currency printed ("$" read as USD, 2003 used); (2) printed "< 0.4" O&M for steam turbines is an upper bound only; (3) Table 10 prints compression-ignition engine electrical efficiency 35-45% while text p.13 says 35-55%; steam turbine overall efficiency up to 80% in Table 10, 80-90% in the text; (4) text under Table 2 says USD 800-1,800/kWh (typo for kW); (5) levelized costs include fuel at the footnoted prices; (6) Table 6 AFC 70% is a hydrogen/oxygen figure; (7) SOFC/MCFC module sizes are printed in MW (converted to kW).
